title: Left ordinary evaluation comparison
statement: Fix the triple product diagram, fixed-scalar ordinary derived pullbacks, tensor comparisons and explicit evaluation composites $\rho,\rho_3$ of [def-pur-ordinary-product-transpose-data]. For arbitrary unbounded $M_i\in D_{X_i}$, $F_i\in D_B$, and arbitrary maps $x_i:L_{f_i}F_i\to M_i$, the composite that transports $L_v$ to $L_{cf_3}$, applies $\rho$ for the outer left square with first map $\rho_{12}(F_1,F_2;x_1,x_2)$ and second map $x_3$, then the specified left external-tensor identification, equals $\rho_3(F_1,F_2,F_3;x_1,x_2,x_3)$. This is an equation only of pullback/tensor comparisons and arbitrary maps; no direct-image product or adjunction appears.

theorem ordinaryTripleLeftComparison :
    (leftDerivedUpperStarCongr (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) d.squareL.w).hom.app
        ((F₁ ⊗ F₂) ⊗ F₃) ≫
      P.ordinaryBinaryEvaluation d.squareL (F₁ ⊗ F₂) F₃
        (P.ordinaryExternal d.p₁ d.p₂ K L) M
        (P.ordinaryBinaryEvaluation d.square₁₂ F₁ F₂ K L x y) z ≫
      (P.ordinaryTripleLeftIdentification d K L M).hom =
    P.ordinaryTripleEvaluation d K L M F₁ F₂ F₃ x y z
